placements.why: The envelope's content is fundamentally architectural — it defines an async job contract governing dispatch, receipt, polling, and lost-work prevention. No existing strata category exists, so Architecture is minted as the organizational home for this and future architectural-contract content.
placements.title: Contracts coordinate components without coupling
placements.theme: Architectural decisions establish how system parts interact, coordinate, and remain resilient under partial failure.

placements.title: Remember returns immediately, completion arrives later
placements.theme: The remember operation dispatches an async job and returns a receipt in seconds, with completion watched via cursor polling or piggybacked on a later call, ensuring no blocking and no lost work if the receipt is dropped.
placements.why: All three segments cohere under one async job contract theme: src-1 ratifies the receipt-and-cursor-polling terms, src-2 asserts no-blocking and no-lost-work guarantees, and src-3 records the dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback decision. No existing leaf holds this; it is a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
